audience: project managers and team leads who run their work in ProofHub

useCases.title: Find overdue and open tasks across projects
useCases.text: Search the tasks of the whole account, filtered by project, label or completion. Ask which open tasks are overdue or assigned to one person.

useCases.title: Review a project and its to-do lists
useCases.text: Open a project to see its status, dates and people. Then list its to-do lists and the tasks in each one.

useCases.title: Read a task and its comments
useCases.text: Get one task with its description, dates, assignees and progress. Then list the comments on the task.

useCases.title: Check logged time across the account
useCases.text: List the time entries of the account, page by page. List the people to see the role and email of each person.

useCases.title: Create a task or post a comment
useCases.text: Create a task in a to-do list, or post a comment on a task. Each call adds a new item, so do not retry blindly.

useCases.title: Mark a task complete or open it again
useCases.text: Mark one task completed, or open it again. Setting the same value twice has no further effect.
